events.summary: Speaker A set the aim: a new remote control that is original, trendy and user friendly.
events.speaker: A
events.quote: which uh has to be original, trendy and of course, user friendly

events.summary: Speaker A set three phases, functional, conceptual and detailed design, each with individual work and a group meeting.
events.speaker: A
events.quote: It consists of three phases, namely the functional design, conceptual design and detailed design

events.summary: Speaker A said the finance department aims for a selling price of 25 EUR.
events.speaker: A
events.quote: aiming for a selling price of twenty five Euros

events.summary: Speaker A said the aim is fifty million EUR in profit.
events.speaker: A
events.quote: we're hoping for a aim of fifty million Euros

events.summary: Speaker A said the production cost will be at most 12.50 EUR.
events.speaker: A
events.quote: the production cost will be twelve Euro fifty max

events.summary: Speaker A said the profit target is to be reached by aiming at an international market.
events.speaker: A
events.quote: we are hoping to achieve that uh by aiming for an international market

events.summary: Speaker B proposed integrating the many separate remotes (stereo, TV) into one.
events.speaker: B
events.quote: perhaps you can integrate them or something

events.summary: Speaker D objected that an integrated remote would still have a lot of buttons.
events.speaker: D
events.quote: you you still have a lot of buttons

events.summary: Speaker C proposed hiding the buttons behind a protective flap, so they show only when needed.
events.speaker: C
events.quote: to put those buttons uh behind some uh kind of uh protection

events.summary: Speaker D objected that a flap would make the remote very big.
events.speaker: D
events.quote: but it'll get very big the the remote control

events.summary: Speaker C proposed only the usual buttons, such as channel zapping and volume, plus numbers, visible on the remote.
events.speaker: C
events.quote: the usual buttons such as uh um zapping uh as you call it in Dutch

events.summary: Speaker A proposed a minimalist design with the fewest possible buttons.
events.speaker: A
events.quote: So maybe a a minimalist design, the least uh possible amount uh of buttons

events.summary: Speaker B objected that every button people need, such as teletext, must still be on the remote.
events.speaker: B
events.quote: you should make sure that you have every button they need on it

events.summary: Speaker B proposed looking at UK television features, since an international remote should consider them.
events.speaker: B
events.quote: you should uh look in think in Britain they have uh different things they can do with the T_V_

events.summary: Speaker D objected that targeting only Britain would push the cost above 12.50 EUR.
events.speaker: D
events.quote: the cost will uh rise higher than the twelve fifty

events.summary: Speaker D said the aim is better as the whole world and Britain, and the group left the UK idea aside.
events.speaker: D
events.quote: I think the aim is better to use uh the whole world and Britain

events.summary: Speaker C said the remote only needs the most used buttons, since customers already have the TV's standard remote.
events.speaker: C
events.quote: it only has to have uh the most used buttons

events.summary: Speaker B objected that without channel search buttons the user must find another remote to search.
events.speaker: B
events.quote: you have to to find your other remote control if you want to search

events.summary: Speaker C said it is impossible to fit all the buttons of different televisions on one remote.
events.speaker: C
events.quote: it is impossible to uh to accommodate uh accommodate uh all the buttons

events.summary: Speaker C objected that one remote cannot work across brands, since a Panasonic remote does not work on a Philips television.
events.speaker: C
events.quote: you can't use a Panasonic uh remote control on a on a Philips television

events.summary: Speaker D proposed a universal remote where the user selects a device code.
events.speaker: D
events.quote: you have to choose the this always with r universal remotes you have to choose the code

events.summary: Speaker C said older televisions need the remote option, so the code choice is not an option for those people.
events.speaker: C
events.quote: perhaps they have a got a an older television, so that option is not uh optional

events.summary: Speaker B said new-TV owners will want the buttons in future, if their remote breaks.
events.speaker: B
events.quote: if you look into the future, then they want will want the button

events.summary: Speaker A assigned Speaker D, the Marketing Expert, to review the user requirement specification.
events.speaker: A
events.quote: the Marketing Expert will uh will take a look at the user requirement specification

events.summary: Speaker A assigned Speaker B, the User Interface Designer, to work out the technical functions design.
events.speaker: A
events.quote: The User Interface Designer will work out the technical functions design

events.summary: Speaker C, the Industrial Designer, committed to look at the working design.
